J1.evidence: Lügat: source glosses (يَلِتْكُمْ) ينقصكم ويظلمكم - affirmative ('diminishes you and wrongs you'). TR renders «Sizi eksiltmez, size zulmetmez», adding a negation not in the Arabic (wrong meaning; should be «Sizi eksiltir, size zulmeder»). Also in i'rab, «[öne geçince hâl oldu]» after «شيئا»nın sıfatı idi» is an unmarked addition (source: لأنه كان صفة لشيئا).

J2.evidence: Lugha: (يَلِتْكُمْ) ينقصكم ويظلمكم is an affirmative gloss of the word ('diminishes you and wrongs you'), as EN has it. TR renders «Sizi eksiltmez, size zulmetmez», adding a negation not in the Arabic (the negation لا belongs to the ayah, not the gloss). Should be «Sizi eksiltir ve size zulmeder». (Also in i'rab: لأنه كان صفة لشيئا is followed by unmarked «[öne geçince hâl oldu]».)

tr.fixed_note: Lügat gloss of يلتكم made affirmative (eksiltir, zulmeder); [öne geçince hâl oldu] put in Mütercim notu
tr.verify_note: Lugha gloss now affirmative ('Sizi eksiltir, size zulmeder'); «[öne geçince hâl olmuştur]» moved into a Mütercim notu. Rest of TR complete and faithful.
